subject: Pilot credits / pricing qualification & burn-rate check-in
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@acme.com>
Cc: Tom Ortiz <tom.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up + pricing qualification items from today's call

Hi Jane / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and appreciate the level of detail on your use cases. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size a pilot and confirm pricing: 

Summary from today
- Primary workload: post-call summarization + triage for clinical intake forms.
- Expected pattern: bursty during business hours, average 10k–20k requests/day with peak days up to 60k.
- Typical prompt + completion length: avg 1,200 tokens per request (prompt 400 / completion 800) — this is a rough early estimate.

Questions / items we need to qualify pricing
1) Target unit economics: Do you have a target $/1M tokens or budget range for this pilot? (helps us recommend model & quantization).
2) Planned pilot duration and success metric (e.g., 30 days, reduce triage time by X or N processed).
3) Any data residency / compliance constraints beyond the SOC2 items we discussed?

Pilot credits request
- You mentioned you may burn through the initial credits faster than expected. If you can share a provisional weekly burn-rate (tokens/week) we can evaluate a short extension and sizing.

Next steps
- If you can reply with an estimated tokens/week + target $/1M tokens, I’ll propose a pilot credit extension and recommended model configuration.
- I’ll loop in Monica on the approvals side once we have the burn estimate.

Thanks — talk soon,

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
Redwood Inference
From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + pricing qualification items from today's call

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with our internal notes. Quick answers below and I attached our rough projected usage spreadsheet.

1) Budget / target unit economics: We're aiming for ~ $900–1200 per 1M tokens for evaluation/POC phase. If we can get closer to $800/1M at pilot scale that would be ideal.
2) Pilot duration / success metrics: 30–45 day pilot; success is 80% reduction in manual triage time and consistent models under our error budget.
3) Compliance: SOC2 + HIPAA (we're in healthcare) — we flagged the HIPAA item earlier. We'll need to review your private deployment options after pilot.

Projected burn (conservative -> aggressive):
- Week 1: 1.2M tokens
- Week 2: 2.6M tokens
- Week 3: 3.8M tokens
- Week 4: 4.0M tokens

We currently have a small internal budget for the pilot (approx $5k–$8k), but the execs indicated they can expand if the pilot shows clear ROI — hence the ask for credits to cover the initial high-burn weeks.

Attachment: acme_projected_usage.xlsx (tabbed by scenario)

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Miller
Head of Clinical Ops, Acme Health
jane.miller@acme.com | +1 617-555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Miller <jane.miller@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tom Ortiz <tom.ortiz@acme.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + pricing qualification items from today's call

Hi Jane — thanks for the detail and the sheet, that helps a lot.

Based on the projected burn and your target unit economics, here's what I can do for the pilot immediately:
- Approve a one-time extension of 2,000,000 free tokens (to be applied over the next two weeks) to cover the initial ramp.
- Suggested configuration: gpt-redwood-compact-8 (quantized) for inference to get closer to $850/1M effective unit cost given your mix. We'll provide perf numbers and a recommended batch/cache config in a follow-up note.
- Approval notes: pilot credits cover inference only; data storage and transfer not included. Pilot period still 30–45 days as discussed.

Please confirm you accept the extension and I'll get the pilot_credit_approval.pdf signed and uploaded to the shared Drive. I'll continue to monitor burn and we can re-evaluate additional credits if you exceed the two-week window.

Cc'ing Monica (finance/ops) for tracking and to confirm no additional contractual steps are required on our side.

— Marissa
Attachment: pilot_credit_approval.pdf (stub — approval for one-time 2,000,000 token credit)
From: Jane Miller <jane.miller@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-06T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + pricing qualification items from today's call

Marissa / Monica,

Confirming we accept the 2M token extension — thank you, this is very helpful. We switched to the compact model yesterday and the early numbers look promising. Quick burn update (end of week 1):
- Actual tokens consumed: ~1.9M
- Observed avg cost pace (if we kept this config): ≈ $920/1M tokens

We'll keep an eye on quality and I expect a short note from our engineers mid-next week with more detailed feedback. Will loop you if we need another short top-up.

Thanks again — appreciate the quick turnaround on the credits approval.

Best,
Jane
